specs.label: Input 1 & 2
specs.value: 3 way 3.5mm euroblock screw terminal input (supplied) with a balanced microphone and line level operation, selectable via rear panel switch, Switchable 250Hz low cut filter, Priority input option (network models only)

specs.label: Microphone / Line
specs.value: Microphone specification; 200 – 600Ω, sensitivity -67dBu, Selectable 24V phantom power on microphone only, Line sensitivity -42dBu, Max line level 17dBu, Max mic level -8dBu

specs.label: Network (optional C5/C7)
specs.value: RJ45 Ethernet, control and monitoring, Hosted web server, Telnet and SNMP

specs.label: Loop Output Drive Voltage
specs.value: 20VRMS (28Vpk) at maximum output current per channel

specs.label: Loop Output/Drive Current
specs.value: 7ARMS (9.9Apk) up to 60 seconds continuous 1kHz sine wave, peak >10A per channel Cont. pink noise 3.3ARMS short term peaks >10A per ch.

specs.label: Loop Connectors
specs.value: 4 way 5mm euroblock screw terminal (supplied) for each output, for twisted pair or star-quad configured feed cables

specs.label: DC Output
specs.value: 2 way 3.5mm euroblock screw terminal Re-settable, fuse protected 12V 0.1A. Controllable to reflect amplifier status (network models only)

specs.label: Line Output
specs.value: 3 way 3.5mm euroblock screw terminal (supplied) post AGC balanced output

specs.label: Status Relay (C10/C14)
specs.value: 2 way 3.5mm euroblock screw terminal (supplied). Normally closed isolated relay contacts, open in fault conditions. Rated load 0.5A at 125VAC, 2A at 30VDC.

specs.label: USB
specs.value: Firmware updates or power for wireless router (200mA max). Powering external devices may reduce power headroom for the loop, DC output and USB power should not be used simultaneously.
